name: Analog Devices, Inc.
summary: Analog Devices, Inc. design, manufacture, tests, and markets portfolio of solutions, including integrated circuits (ICs); software and subsystems; analog and mixed signal; and digital technologies products in the United States, rest of North and South America, Europe, Japan, China, and rest of Asia. The company provides data converter products, which translate real-world analog signals into digital data, as well as translates digital data into analog signals; power management and reference products for power conversion, driver monitoring, sequencing, and energy management applications in the automotive, communications, industrial, and consumer markets; and power ICs that include performance,…
